# MDCard

Transform Markdown into beautiful share cards

## Features

- **16 theme palettes** one-click switch
- **Glassmorphism UI** modern design language
- **Watermark & config sharing** for authorship protection

===

## Quick Start

1. Write Markdown on the left
2. Click the 🃏 button to open style panel
3. Pick a theme or customize colors
4. Export as PNG / JPG

> Use === to force page break, --- to render a divider
